remarks: Tucked away on approximately 5.6 peaceful acres just outside the Village of Ellicottville, 7362 Windsor Road offers the kind of quiet country setting that is getting harder to find. This contemporary chalet-style home blends natural beauty, privacy, and year-round lifestyle living only minutes from HoliMont, Holiday Valley, golf, hiking, dining, and the heart of Ellicottville. The property features 4 bedrooms, 2 full baths, soaring ceilings, and an open-concept living space centered around a stunning floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace that creates the perfect gathering spot after a day on the slopes or exploring the outdoors. Large windows and sliding glass doors bring the outside in while filling the home with natural light and views of the surrounding landscape. Step outside onto the expansive wraparound deck and take in the peaceful setting filled with mature trees, open green space, and room to roam. One of the most unique features of this property is the detached backyard star observatory — a rare and creative retreat for astronomy lovers, stargazers, photographers, or anyone who appreciates quiet nights under the Western New York sky. The home also features a spacious primary bath with soaking tub, comfortable guest spaces, and a warm rustic character throughout that feels true to Ellicottville living.  Whether you are searching for a full-time residence, weekend getaway, ski retreat, or investment opportunity as it can be rented short term with no permit required. This property delivers privacy, charm, and a setting that truly stands apart. Fully furnished
